notes.title: Lost Abroad Café v1.06.02 -- Bug Fixes
notes.content: [p]Over the past several months, we have seen an increasing number of bugs relating to customers walking up to the counter and not ordering. This was caused by spotty service from our text-to-speech provider, and we made updates in our backend to make multiple attempts to create sound for the randomly generated order combinations for each voice. However, this past week, the service has apparently gone down completely without notification.[/p][p][/p][p]Thankfully, this has given us the kick in the butt we needed to move off this provider and fix the issue for good. Over the years we have generated nearly 90,000 unique soundbites covering almost every combination of items that can be ordered in Lost Abroad Café (although not necessarily for each type of character), and rather than set up a new dependency we have decided to simply use what we already have by only generating character-order-sound combinations that already exist. This also makes the customer generation process much faster, so issues particularly with the first customer in a round are also fixed.[/p][p][/p][p]For both long-time players and those that just purchased recently during the Summer Sale, we hope that this update makes your experience even better![/p]

notes.title: Lost Abroad Café Update - Anti-Greetings!
notes.content:
We have a short but sweet update that's now live in Lost Abroad Café!

[h2]Anti-Greetings[/h2]

Previously, you could easily just tap any greeting you like when a customer came up to your counter and they'd give you their order. It wasn't very engaging, and it didn't make a difference which option you selected.

But now, occasionally we'll sneak in an "anti-greeting" option, or something that wouldn't really make sense to say to a customer walking up to your store. For most languages this will be saying "Goodbye" instead of "Hello" or "Welcome" to start. Be careful, pay attention, and choose wisely!

[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/6043d3eecf5af74e6a69b565/6aa0bc9d-c8b0-4f78-b93f-2f516ab709bf/anti-greetings-final.gif?content-type=image%2Fgif[/img]

[h2]New Game Survey[/h2]

In case you missed it, the Principal Educator for Lost Abroad, Jack Du, sent out an email this week with some exciting news: after 2 years building Lost Abroad Café we are now ready to start building our next game! We put together a survey with 7 of our new ideas, and we'd love to hear your thoughts on them. The short survey will only take about 5 minutes to complete, check it out here: https://forms.gle/PjYYL7xseLNxH1Ug7

notes.title: Winter Update - New Café Environments, Pets, and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
We have some great gifts for you in the New Year with our Winter Update! Let's take a look!

[h2]New Café Environments[/h2]

For stores in Seoul, Tokyo, and Mexico City, we have new environments that reflect the look and feel of these locations! Check them out, with more coming!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/1933cf3d823ec5d14d0914526ea15cdfa0cc31c3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/14cefdcfa7fc603ef871b58ff60477f0bd6a2f0e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/5c61a34eba1efcac2f8d48c5e0c592fd53e40967.png[/img]

[h2]Pets (via Refer a Friend)[/h2]

Ready to liven up your coffee shop? There are now 18 different pets you can get to roam your store! Dogs, cats, rabbits, ducks, and even some that are more rare!

Each time you use refer a friend via the language select screen and they complete the tutorial, both of you will receive a new pet to roam your store.

If you're learning multiple languages, don't worry -- your pets will follow you along around the world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/0d529caca43422c3b6ce9835d86779d3e0b8680e.png[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

A few of you encountered an interesting bug with the equipment upgrades: if your device was set up to use a language that uses a comma instead of a period for the decimal separator (ex: "2,5" instead of "2.5"), then getting the first "upgrade" for any piece of equipment would cause it to take 25 seconds to fill a cup instead of 2.5! Thankfully this was a quick fix, and you can now be assured that the coins you spend on upgrades will in fact improve the equipment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/660117f87c96909f18e07cc738100f54352b9bca.png[/img]

We can't wait for you to check out all our awesome new features! Open your coffee shop in Lost Abroad Café and start (or continue) learning a new language today!

notes.title: Fall into Language Learning: Autumn Update
notes.content:
Get ready to Fall into Language Learning with our Autumn Update! This is our biggest update ever, so get ready to open your coffee shop, serve your customers, build your business, and learn a language while doing it with even more new features!

[h2]New Greetings[/h2]

"Hello!", "Welcome", "What can I get you?" -- Just like when we introduced new ways for customers to order in the Spring, now we're giving you the ability to choose how you greet your customers! Each language now has multiple options to greet your customers -- use the question mark icon to learn their meanings, and choose the one that works for you! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/513ec0e4d40c060bf802980d3b647361e71c15c3.png[/img]

[h2]New Language-Specific Items[/h2]

Every language has a new food or drink item customized for that location. Check out your store to see what's new!

As one example, in Korean we have added "바나나 우유", or Banana Milk, as a new item in the fridge! Banana Milk is a beloved beverage in South Korea, often associated with childhood memories and seen as a cultural icon. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/dab3b930b9ed50d70363c6f8da1e4d2f052d314f.png[/img]

[h2]New Machine Upgrades[/h2]

Do you have a line building up out the door, and you just can't serve fast enough? You can now upgrade your ice, hot water, and coffee machines to operate faster! Each machine has 5 levels of upgrades, with the highest level bringing fill time down to only half a second! You'll be serving up your customers and getting them out the door in no time at all! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/660117f87c96909f18e07cc738100f54352b9bca.png[/img]

[h2]New Voice/Text Settings[/h2]

Want to give yourself a challenge? Try turning off the pronunciations for Asian languages, playing without text at all and just relying on sound, or vice versa! The settings menu in the upper right allows you to choose what information you get from your customers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/51593c2ca2c49b80cf2d29071d3c2d4cf229ca44.png[/img]

We can't wait for you to check out all our awesome new additions! Open your coffee shop in Lost Abroad Café and Fall into Language Learning today!

notes.title: July Update - New Music, Sound Effects, and Pronunciation Guides
notes.content:
[h3]New Music and Sound Effects[/h3]

Over the past several months we've been working with two great community members, vxlkyrie and Hero A, to compose custom music for each language you can learn in game! The new beats do a great job at capturing the feel of each country, so check them out and show some love on our Discord channel!
In addition to the new music, we've added sound effects to enhance your in-game actions. Whether you're filling cups with water, coffee, or milk or skillfully moving plates and pastries around, the audio feedback provides a great new tactile experience while serving your customers!

[h3]Pronunciation Guides[/h3]

When learning a language that doesn't use the Roman alphabet, it can be difficult to get started with reading. So we've introduced Ruby Text for Chinese, Japanese, and Korean that shows a transliteration of the words above the characters themselves. In future updates, we'll be adding the ability to disable this as you get more comfortable, and also support a Furigana option for Japanese (hiragana transliterations for Kanji characters).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/e1d10ca73f659cfc4b02873b24d44e2a5e7df900.png[/img]

In our next update, we'll be including ways to challenge yourself by enabling/disabling the text or sound entirely, as well as a new conversational feature where you'll be able to learn more greetings for each language!

notes.title: June Update - New Management Mode and Interactive Intro
notes.content:
We at Lost Abroad hope you're having a great start to your summer! We've got some cool new updates to help you start or continue your journey with Lost Abroad Café!

[h2]New Management Phase[/h2]

We've made three improvements to the Management Phase:

[olist]
[*]The equipment purchasing screen is no more, and now you can see everything you can purchase right on your countertop! See what your completed coffee shop will look like, and confirm before you purchase.
[*]There's now an equipment counter in the upper left of the screen to show your progress. Buy up everything you can, and reach 100% (at least, until we add even more content!).
[*]The menu is now an actual object underneath your countertop (to the left of the cups). Click on it during gameplay or the management phase to review all your available orders.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/5a35a2896e899658ae94db370b15b47f44aaeeb1.gif[/img]

[h2]New Interactive Introduction[/h2]

When launching a new store for the first time, you'll now be walked through an interactive introduction phase to go through the beginning mechanics of listening to an order, studying individual words, making an order, buying equipment, and reviewing your menu! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/1b188abee7780d969e32a61c511535a4da36664e.gif[/img]

notes.title: May Updates - New Order Methods, Environment, and Leaderboard!
notes.content:
We've got some great new features and updates to announce for May!

First up, earlier this month we added several new grammatical patterns to Lost Abroad Café to reflect how, in real life, not everybody orders the same way. In English you might say "I'll have a large coffee", or "Large coffee, please", or many other variations. For all 7 available languages, there are now at least 4 (and in some cases more) ways that customers will order!

In order to not be overwhelmed, when opening your store customers will only use one method. However, as you serve more customers, new patterns will be unlocked. Keep playing and learn them all!

Here are a few samples of our new order phrases:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/257a3a47b8116b084de5819e62c92044b0c355e7.jpg[/img]

Additionally, we've made several fixes to the language used -- in romance languages there were some issues where the wrong masculine/feminine words were used, and there were some other spelling/grammatical errors as well such as nouns in German not being capitalized.

Next, we've just added a redesigned and improved coffee shop environment! Invite customers to enjoy this sleek, bright, modern café:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/575fcc5144c0d3d181ff9976c74bb0fd1c321bc8.png[/img]

Finally, we've reconfigured the leaderboard to be based on your shop's revenue instead of just the customers served. Especially once you get more complex drinks, it becomes difficult to serve as many customers as when they would only order coffee, tea, or muffins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/2eef3c1e7d4164083344948c48b8db6e58c2fd48.png[/img]

notes.title: April Update #1 - Countertup Upgrades, Customer UI, and Strawberry Milk
notes.content:
In case you missed it, earlier this month we announced our [url=https://wefunder.com/lost.abroad.inc]equity crowdfunding campaign on Wefunder[/url], which has already amassed nearly $25,000! Check it out, support us, and become a part-owner of the Lost Abroad company!

Additionally, in the past few weeks we've seen two more content creators play Lost Abroad Cafe. Check out [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=82ancQDU9uE]Korean culture YouTuber Zuzu play Korean[/url], or watch [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1793056846]vtuber LiLi_Pupp do a full playthrough on Twitch of Chinese[/url] (plus a little bit of German and Korean).

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[h3]Countertop Upgrades[/h3]
Firstly, we've noticed that as you all have become more skilled, you've been craving the ability to queue up orders and serve customers even faster. To help you achieve that, we're introducing purchasable countertop spots! You'll now be able to purchase additional spaces to work with during gameplay. This means you can keep more coffee on hand or even some hot water to drop in a tea bag and go! We can't wait to see what creative ways you come up with to use your new space

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/0eb17f2f5c8110c5d77a22b21ae333b0ec4cbaeb.gif[/img]

[h3]Customer Greeting UI[/h3]
We noticed that some players were clicking on customers in line and accidentally skipping ahead to the customer at the counter who hadn't ordered yet. To make it clearer, we've made the greeting button blue, and we hope this helps you avoid any confusion.

Also, you can catch in the gif below that we've updated the plates to be draggable, just like how cups work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/89e971916c239c5c7d727f0f3bda4eb434c9ea06.gif[/img]

[h3](Korean Only) Strawberry Milk[/h3]
Finally, we've added a popular drink to our Korean options - the delicious strawberry milk! This will now be available as an option for you to serve to your customers as strawberry lattes (and mochas to come).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/aee5b331634f7decba4f816cc137248917bf4a15.gif[/img]

[h3]Steam Achievements[/h3]
Achievements on Steam are now live! If you've purchased and play the game on Steam, it's now even easier to show off to all your friends how much progress you're making!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/bd413ed559878f7cf343353df3a4883db33a3056.png[/img]

In our next update we'll be delivering our most recent feature poll with various order options. There are tons of ways to order a coffee in English. Think "I'll have a coffee", "Can I get a coffee", "Coffee, please", "Hi! I would like a coffee", and the list goes on. Other languages are no different -- with this update, customers will use different words and sentence structures to order the same items from your store.

notes.title: March Update 2 - Refrigerator, Bottled Water, and Concha
notes.content:
Super exciting news: Lost Abroad Café has been featured in our first YouTube Let's Play! [url=https://www.youtube.com/@DadDude]@DadDude[/url], a gaming YouTuber, just posted his playthrough completing all the content (that is, all the content before today's update) for Japanese! Give his channel some love, and check out the video here:

[previewyoutube=nKlBn5IWmjM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[h3]Refrigerator + Bottled Water[/h3]
Continuing to fill out the serving counter, we have a new piece of equipment that will be a hub for additional new items: a mini-fridge! Located below the pastries/food, the refrigerator will allow you to serve ready-to-eat/drink cold items to your customers. The first item you can add to your mini-fridge and begin serving is bottled water!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/c2f68dbf2c0a6f9f5601b843c35b5db683e2b0d5.gif[/img]

[h3](Spanish Only) Concha[/h3]

As mentioned, for players with a shop in Mexico City we've added the concha (literally meaning "shell" in Spanish), a type of "pan dulce" (traditional Mexican sweet bread roll). Look out for more additions to other languages in April!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/44f5809e6e3d0edcefded32672270cff05a7f8de.gif[/img]

[h1]What's Next[/h1]

In addition to more and more equipment to add to your store, we're beginning to work on some awesome visual and audio improvements to the game by adding custom music to each locale, a re-designed coffee shop, and adding sound effects to the equipment!

We'll also be adding Steam stats and achievements in April so you can show off to all your friends your new language skills.

notes.title: March Update 1 - Expanded Time Modes
notes.content:
"I feel like we should have way more than 60 seconds to serve customers"
"I would like to be able to change how much time I am allowed per cafe session."
"I think the duration for each session feels too short for me. 60 s to prepare everything seems too short"

I'll cut straight to the chase this time: you asked (very nicely!) and it's here. Our newest patch includes...

[h3]New Feature: Expanded Time Modes![/h3]

Use your in-game coin to purchase upgrades to play for 2 or 5 minute rounds and get Lost Abroad for even longer

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/09d1c41ef363e7bc1bcdfc77935da5d8ddc243b3.png[/img]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

[b]Overlapping text[/b]

With the addition of longer orders, we ran into an issue where sometimes words would overlap each other on the last line. We've made the overall speech bubbles a little bit wider, and introduced some checks to make sure this bug doesn't continue to occur.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/22361263d1ccc9da8143c0fdfd88c0fed497f3a9.jpg[/img]

[b]Tutorial Order Replacements[/b]

When pressing the question mark next to a menu item to practice it, there was an issue where it would be replaced by a random other order. This has been fixed.

[b]Further Fixes to Empty Orders[/b]

A new pesky bug that just won't get squashed. We've introduced a few additional changes to limit this bug, but it will still occur occasionally.

This month we'll be introducing some special food and drinks for specific languages and cultures. Our first addition is the Mexican concha (literally meaning "shell" in Spanish), a type of "pan dulce" (traditional Mexican sweet bread roll). Conchas get their name from their round shape and their striped, seashell-like appearance. A concha consists of two parts: a sweetened bread roll, and a crunchy topping composed of flour, butter, and sugar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/56a8939c7ed9a9a118ce269f19c27ea5ef89714e.png[/img]

Be sure to let us know on Discord what you want added to your café for your target language!

notes.title: Lost Abroad Café - February Update #2
notes.content:
For our second and final update of February we have a few exciting features and necessary improvements and bug fixes

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[b]Achievements[/b]

Everyone loves getting rewarded, and now you too can celebrate as you serve more and more orders to customers. We've got a small set of achievements set up now, with many more to come! Can you 100% Lost Abroad Café?

Note that for now these are in-game achievements, but we'll link them to Steam profile Achievements in the near future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/f8ed00721bb24fd614267842716194d3f6b4a409.gif[/img]

[b]Sandwiches[/b]

A staple all around the world, you can now serve up sandwiches as a food item in your coffee shop! And for the first time, not all languages will have the same option: Asian languages will get one sandwich, and romance/European languages another. This is our first test on setting up different menu items for different languages, and going forward we'll be able to get even more specific and culturally relevant!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/4222248be349b46fcae659e0468431b7221edb28.png[/img]

[b]Update Username/Email[/b]

Things change, and the username you registered with might not be the one you still want to use. You can now update your username and email address using the User button on the language select screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/ea538692d4f38eedc13f662f8c55dc75dd6ddbc8.png[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[b]Words in Wrong Place[/b]

You may have noticed that in some cases, short words would be moved around so that they showed up in the wrong place in the speech bubble. This has been fixed, and the speech bubbles now match what the customers actually say.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/3fe63649ffd06284b034eb60edf2da92ae93ae1f.png[/img]

[b]Empty Speech Bubbles[/b]

There were some cases where clicking on a customer's speech bubble to hear their order too quickly resulted in it staying empty, or being stuck on "...". We haven't fully found and fixed the root cause of this, but we have made some changes that make it occur much less often.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335919/72b7001d906e645c1e5ff7a688d24f863b77f8bd.png[/img]

Next month we'll be adding one of the most requested features to date: expanded time modes! Play 1, 2, or 5 minute rounds depending on your own schedule. Then we've got even more coming down the pipeline, including the winner of our February feature poll on our [url=https://discord.gg/ATTrqbNj7w]Discord server[/url] (remember to vote if you haven't already!).

notes.title: Lost Abroad Café - February Update #1
notes.content:
Our first update of the new year is finally here! We've got three highly requested features ready to roll out

[h2]Multi-Item Orders[/h2]

Multi-Item Orders was the winner of the December feature poll on our [url=https://discord.gg/ATTrqbNj7w]Discord[/url], and we're super excited for it to go live!

Once you've served at least 50 customers in a specific language, new customers have a chance to order two separate items at once (ex: "I'll have a coffee and a muffin"). This obviously is a super common grammatical structure, and it challenges you to complete orders faster than ever. To help you keep track of what you've already given a customer, the items will float in front of them until their order is complete. See how well you can continue racking up customers with Multi-Item Orders!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43335919/067bfd5483a8b5d87f628b8371c2c4fbfe60fdaa.gif[/img]

[h2]Clickable Word Descriptions[/h2]

Learning a language is tough, and starting out it's at it's hardest when you can't understand anything. That's why we've ported over Clickable Words from out coffee shop intro for Chinese into the main game for all languages. Don't know what a customer is trying to order? Just click on one of the words in their speech bubble to see a translation along with a little icon to help you remember. In the future, we'll also include pronunciation guidelines, fun facts, and the ability to hear a word in isolation within this feature.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43335919/592832f031b0d57173f5cf3c34bdb07ed298bc57.gif[/img]

[h2]Steam Auto-Login[/h2]

Our first use of Steam-specific functions is to remove the need for you to create a separate Lost Abroad account in order to play. Now all you need is to play through Steam, and your progress will be saved for you!

We'll have 1-2 more small updates coming out this month to fix up some bugs and add additional features and content. Be sure to [url=https://discord.gg/ATTrqbNj7w]Join our Discord[/url] to let us know about bugs you encounter, share your ideas for the game, vote in our feature polls, and meet other language learning gamers like yourself!

notes.title: Lost Abroad Café Early Access Launch: Join the Language Learning Adventure!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that Lost Abroad Café is now available for Early Access on Steam!

Our team has been hard at work creating a unique and engaging experience that combines the fun of a café management game with the challenge of learning a new language. You can choose to learn Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Spanish, French, Italian, or German while serving coffee, tea, and snacks to customers in a virtual café.

We typically have 1-2 updates per month and are actively building out new language content/equipment, new features like our leaderboard and upcoming achievements, and will be getting into more game polish with updated graphics, UI, audio, and more!

Learning a new language has numerous benefits, including improved cognitive function and memory, expanded career opportunities, and the ability to connect with people from different cultures. With Lost Abroad Café, you can learn a new language in a fun and engaging way that immerses you in the language and culture. Through regular practice and repetition, you will improve your language skills and, most importantly, be able to associate what you learn with real objects and actions, not just text-based translations.

We can't wait for you to join us on this language learning journey. So come on in to Lost Abroad Café and let the fun begin!

Best regards,
The Lost Abroad Team
